title: Shop Thermostat
description: The purpose of this RenderWeekly project was to find a rugged thermostat form that could be used in a shop environment as an assistant, and could be easily read and adjusted from across the room.

brief.label: Brief
brief.text: A RenderWeekly project: a rugged thermostat for a shop that also acts as an assistant.

brief.label: Users
brief.text: People working in a shop or garage who need to read and adjust the temperature from across the room.

brief.label: Design response
brief.text: Large numerals and a big dial in a rugged housing, mounted to the shop wall.

study_intro: Built for the shop, not the living room: legible from across the room and tough enough to live next to tools.

study.label: Form
study.text: A rounded square with one curved corner, carrying big numerals and an arc gauge.

study.label: Legibility
study.text: Oversized temperature readout and a clear color arc, readable from a distance.

study.label: Detail
study.text: A rugged knob and a perforated-rail mount that matches pegboard and shelving.

study.label: Material
study.text: Dark and off-white housings that sit with timber, steel and pegboard.
